remarks:
Move right in to this charming, private, quiet location in Alpine Meadows. Just a short walk to skiing and other activities at Holiday Valley Resort. Restaurants within walking distance.  Easy walk to town as well,
Professionally decorated with delightful finishes.
 Pristine interior with two bedrooms, full bath and laundry on first floor. 
Open concept second floor with convenient half bath offers a great entertaining area for your family and guests.  Huge deck backing up to beautiful foliage offering privacy for you right off the living room. 
The 3rd level has a primary bedroom, full bath and closet. Extra storage is under the windows and dresser built in. Upgraded baths throughout.

Many upgrades over the years make this an easy turn-key getaway for you and your family.
